name: Eye of the Swarm
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level adept 3, bard 3, druid 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3, witch 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range self
Area see text
Duration concentration + 2 rounds
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon a swarm of bats, rats, or spiders (your choice) that occupies your space(s) and 10 feet in all directions from you. The swarm affects any creature that enters the area of the swarm. The swarm stays with you and moves with you as you move.
